name: Classic Chocolate Fudge Mug Cake
ingredients: Whey protein concentrate 80 (unflavoured) 8 g; Micellar casein 5 g; Almond flour (blanched) 10 g; Rice flour (fine) 8 g; Cocoa powder (Dutch, 20-22% fat) 8 g; Erythritol 10 g; Stevia (Reb-A 97%) 0.04 g; Dark chocolate chips 55% (sugar-reduced) 5 g; Psyllium husk powder 1 g; Xanthan gum 0.2 g; Baking powder (GF, double-acting) 2 g; Baking soda 0.2 g; Salt 0.3 g; Natural vanilla flavour powder 0.3 g
liquid: 50-55 ml milk or water (milk = richer); stir 30 s to smooth batter
microwave: 60-75 s at 800-900 W in a 300-350 ml greased mug; start 60 s, add 10 s bursts; rest 1 min (carryover)
air_fryer: 9-11 min at 150°C in greased ramekin/silicone cup; cover with foil last 3 min if top browns
pressure_cooker: Steel bowl covered with foil on stand in cooker with 1 cup water, NO whistle/weight, medium-low 12-15 min
notes: Standard (≥10 g) tier. Whey:casein 60:40 keeps it fudgy; Dutch cocoa + soda for dark colour/rise. Vegetarian (contains milk). Nutrition values are ESTIMATES from standard per-100g values for dry mix only; add ~2 g protein/60 kcal if made with 60 ml toned milk. Carbs are TOTAL incl. erythritol/allulose/fibre (net digestible carbs much lower). Cost = ingredients only; add ~₹4-7 for metallised/foil sachet + blending/filling.
